summary: Adapter runner asked for runtime inputs even though the adapter contract had default values.
expected_behavior: When adapter.yaml defines default_inputs for all inputs, adapter-runner should use the defaults without asking the project owner.
actual_behavior: adapter-runner asked the project owner for workflow_name, target, expected_fields, and freshness_requirement.
user_correction: the project owner said the fixture adapter already has defaults and the runner should not ask.
